etymology.historical_story: Angelo is an Italian personal name associated with the Italian word for an angel. That word continues Late Latin angelus, ultimately from Greek angelos, meaning messenger. The connection explains the name's historical symbolism; it does not make Angelo a Malay word meaning angel or establish the identity of this packet's referent. See [name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/angelo) and [Treccani](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/angelo/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Angelo，联想到英文 angel 来记人名；马来语的天使仍是 malaikat。
